mentions.name: emira
mentions.description: A tiling-scrolling window manager for macOS built around a compositor-overlay approach: during transitions such as scrolling on focus or moving windows, an overlay animates using screenshots of the windows while the real windows move underneath, then dissolves once windows are in place, making transitions feel closer to native.
